"""Check original Native capture completion and lifecycle before saved conversion."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from measure_readiness import FRAMES, lines, sha
from scene import CASES, request
from branch_variants import VARIANTS, RESPONSES, variant_request


BRANCH_CASES = tuple(f"{variant}__{response}"
                     for variant in VARIANTS for response in RESPONSES)


def exact_request(condition):
    if condition in CASES:
        return request(condition)
    if condition in BRANCH_CASES:
        variant, response = condition.rsplit("__", 1)
        return variant_request(variant, response)
    raise ValueError("Unknown exact condition")


def audit(directory, condition):
    exact = exact_request(condition)
    root = Path(directory)
    paths = {name: root / name for name in (
        "native-request.json", "native-map-readback.json", "native-capture-report.json",
        "observed-actors.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "scene.xodr")}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing original capture source: " + name)
    if json.loads(paths["native-request.json"].read_text()) != exact:
        raise ValueError("Capture request differs from exact construction")
    if paths["scene.xodr"].read_text().rstrip("\n") != exact["source_map"]:
        raise ValueError("Original OpenDRIVE differs from exact construction")
    map_readback = json.loads(paths["native-map-readback.json"].read_text())
    actual_map_hash = map_readback.get("original_opendrive_sha256")
    if (map_readback.get("requested_map_sha256") != hashlib.sha256(
            exact["source_map"].encode()).hexdigest() or
            map_readback.get("initial_road_id") != exact["road_id"] or
            type(actual_map_hash) is not str or len(actual_map_hash) != 64 or
            any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in actual_map_hash)):
        raise ValueError("Native map readback is incomplete or changed")
    report = json.loads(paths["native-capture-report.json"].read_text())
    if (report.get("case_id") != exact["case_id"] or report.get("frames") != FRAMES or
            report.get("expected_frames") != FRAMES or report.get("error") is not None or
            report.get("accepted") is not False):
        raise ValueError("Native capture report is incomplete or claims acceptance")
    restoration = report.get("restoration")
    if not isinstance(restoration, dict) or restoration.get("restored") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Native world restoration did not pass")
    observed = lines(paths["observed-actors.jsonl"])
    frames = lines(paths["video_frames.jsonl"])
    if len(observed) != FRAMES or len(frames) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Original Native and video frame counts must be 600")
    previous_native, previous_actor_time = -1, None
    indication_actor_id = None
    for i, (row, frame) in enumerate(zip(observed, frames)):
        native = frame.get("native_frame")
        if (row.get("frame") != i or frame.get("video_frame") != i or
                type(native) is not int or (i and native != previous_native + 1) or
                row.get("native_frame") != native or
                row.get("source_kind") != "original_native_motion"):
            raise ValueError("Original Native and video frame join failed")
        if not isinstance(row.get("actors"), dict) or set(row["actors"]) != {"ego", "emergency"}:
            raise ValueError("Original actor readback missing")
        for name in ("ego", "emergency"):
            actor = row["actors"][name]
            center, body = actor.get("native_center_xy_m"), actor.get("native_body_xy_m")
            if (not isinstance(center, list) or len(center) != 2 or
                    not all(type(x) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(x) for x in center) or
                    not isinstance(body, list) or len(body) < 4 or
                    any(not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 2 or
                        not all(type(x) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(x) for x in point)
                        for point in body) or
                    type(actor.get("native_speed_mps")) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isfinite(actor["native_speed_mps"]) or actor["native_speed_mps"] < 0):
                raise ValueError("Original actor geometry or speed readback missing")
        brake, requested_brake = row.get("ego_brake_observed"), row.get("ego_brake_request")
        if (type(brake) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(brake) or
                not 0 <= brake <= 1 or type(requested_brake) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isfinite(requested_brake) or not 0 <= requested_brake <= 1 or
                type(row.get("lamp_state_observed")) is not bool or
                type(row.get("lamp_request")) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("Original brake or lamp readback missing")
        if abs(brake - requested_brake) > .001 or row["lamp_state_observed"] != row["lamp_request"]:
            raise ValueError("Original brake or lamp request/readback mismatch")
        if condition in BRANCH_CASES:
            field = "source_driver_proxy" if exact["variant"] == "visible_driver_hand_signal" else "officer_actor"
            interval = exact[field]["signal_frames" if field == "source_driver_proxy" else "direction_frames"]
            indication_rows = row.get("indication_native_readback")
            if not isinstance(indication_rows, dict):
                raise ValueError("Native indication readback missing")
            readback = indication_rows.get(field, {})
            if interval[0] <= i <= interval[1] and readback.get("native_bones_read_back") is not True:
                raise ValueError("Native indication pose readback missing")
            if i == interval[1] + 1 and readback.get("pose_hidden") is not True:
                raise ValueError("Native indication pose was not hidden")
            if interval[0] <= i <= interval[1] + 1:
                actor_id = readback.get("native_actor_id")
                if type(actor_id) is not int or actor_id <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Native indication actor identity missing")
                if indication_actor_id is not None and actor_id != indication_actor_id:
                    raise ValueError("Native indication actor identity changed")
                indication_actor_id = actor_id
            if (field == "source_driver_proxy" and interval[0] <= i <= interval[1] and
                    row["actors"]["emergency"]["native_speed_mps"] > .25):
                raise ValueError("Hand-signal source moved during requested stationary interval")
        t = frame.get("time_s")
        if type(t) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(t) or abs(t - i / 20) > .005:
            raise ValueError("Original video cadence differs from 20 Hz")
        actor_time = row.get("time_s")
        if (type(actor_time) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(actor_time) or
                (previous_actor_time is not None and
                 abs(actor_time - previous_actor_time - .05) > .005)):
            raise ValueError("Original Native cadence differs from 20 Hz")
        previous_native = native
        previous_actor_time = actor_time
    return {"format": "original-capture-lifecycle-audit", "case_id": exact["case_id"],
            "sample_count": FRAMES, "restoration_passed": True,
            "source_sha256": {name: sha(path) for name, path in paths.items()},
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("directory")
    parser.add_argument("condition", choices=CASES + BRANCH_CASES)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit(args.directory, args.condition), sort_keys=True))

def check_pair(variant):
    first, second = (variant_request(variant, name) for name in RESPONSES)
    fixed = set(first) - {"case_id", "requested_setting", "ego_response_policy"}
    if {key: first[key] for key in fixed} != {key: second[key] for key in fixed}:
        raise ValueError("Branch response pair changed a fixed source condition")
    if first["ego_response_policy"] == second["ego_response_policy"]:
        raise ValueError("Branch response contrast absent")
    if variant == "visible_driver_hand_signal":
        if first["source_driver_proxy"]["signal_frames"] != [150, 199]:
            raise ValueError("Source driver hand interval changed")
        if first["emergency_motion_start_frame"] <= 199:
            raise ValueError("Source vehicle must remain stopped through hand signal")
    if variant == "officer_directed_otherwise":
        if first["officer_actor"]["direction_frames"] != [150, 199]:
            raise ValueError("Officer direction interval changed")
    return first, second


def write():
    target = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "branch-requests"
    target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    ids = []
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        for item in check_pair(variant):
            path = target / (variant + "__" + item["requested_setting"] + ".json")
            path.write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            ids.append(item["case_id"])
    return ids

"""Convert original Native pose/control rows and explicit pixel review to a trace.

The reviewer supplies every frame-bound visibility fact. Geometry and braking
come only from original Native observations. This conversion makes no verdict.
"""

import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from measure_readiness import ASSIGNMENT, CAMERAS, FRAMES, lines
from audit_capture import audit as audit_capture
from branch_source_review import validate as validate_branch_review
from audit_capture import BRANCH_CASES, exact_request
from scene import CASES


FLAGS = ("emergency_flashing_visible", "emergency_motion_visible",
         "hand_signal_visible")


def _finite(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def _surface_gap(first, second):
    def bounds(points):
        if not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) < 4 or any(len(point) != 2 or
                                  not all(_finite(coordinate) for coordinate in point)
                                  for point in points):
            raise ValueError("Original Native body vertices missing")
        return (min(p[0] for p in points), max(p[0] for p in points),
                min(p[1] for p in points), max(p[1] for p in points))
    a, b = bounds(first), bounds(second)
    dx = max(0, a[0] - b[1], b[0] - a[1])
    dy = max(0, a[2] - b[3], b[2] - a[3])
    return math.hypot(dx, dy)


def convert(frames, observed, annotations):
    if len(frames) != FRAMES or len(observed) != FRAMES or len(annotations) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Original frame, actor and pixel-review counts must be 600")
    output = []
    for index, (frame, row, note) in enumerate(zip(frames, observed, annotations)):
        native = frame.get("native_frame")
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or type(native) is not int or
                row.get("frame") != index or row.get("native_frame") != native or
                note.get("video_frame") != index):
            raise ValueError("Original Native, video and review frame join failed")
        if row.get("source_kind") != "original_native_motion":
            raise ValueError("Motion provenance must be original Native")
        if note.get("source_camera") not in CAMERAS or note.get("source_native_frame") != native:
            raise ValueError("Frame-bound original pixel source missing")
        if any(type(note.get(flag)) is not bool for flag in FLAGS):
            raise ValueError("Frame-bound visibility review missing")
        actors = row.get("actors", {})
        ego, emergency = actors.get("ego", {}), actors.get("emergency", {})
        for name, actor in (("ego", ego), ("emergency", emergency)):
            if not _finite(actor.get("native_speed_mps")) or actor["native_speed_mps"] < 0:
                raise ValueError(name + " original speed missing")
        brake = row.get("ego_brake_observed")
        if not _finite(brake) or not 0 <= brake <= 1:
            raise ValueError("Original Native ego brake readback missing")
        output.append({"video_frame": index, "native_frame": native,
                       "source_kind": "original_native_motion",
                       "ego_speed_mps": ego["native_speed_mps"],
                       "emergency_speed_mps": emergency["native_speed_mps"],
                       "surface_gap_m": _surface_gap(ego.get("native_body_xy_m"),
                                                     emergency.get("native_body_xy_m")),
                       "ego_brake": brake,
                       **{flag: note[flag] for flag in FLAGS}})
    return output


def process(directory):
    directory = Path(directory).resolve()
    if ".runtime-work" not in directory.parts:
        raise ValueError("Original attempt must be under .runtime-work")
    frame_path, actor_path = directory / "video_frames.jsonl", directory / "observed-actors.jsonl"

"""Prospective original Native acquisition for the exact emergency-approach pair.

CPU ``--check`` validates the authored request. A physical run requires an idle,
exclusive CARLA server and writes all temporary media outside ``work/``.
Original pixels and independent review are required before acceptance.

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback

from scene import ASSIGNMENT, CASES, CAMERA_DIMENSIONS, check_pair, request
from branch_variants import VARIANTS, RESPONSES, check_pair as check_branch_pair, variant_request
from indication_actors import apply_indication, spawn_indication_actor


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = next((parent for parent in HERE.parents if (parent / 'runtime.py').is_file()), None)
if REPO is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Worker repository root not found')


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


BRANCH_CASES = tuple(f"{variant}__{response}"
                     for variant in VARIANTS for response in RESPONSES)


def resolve_case(case):
    if case in CASES:
        return request(case), HERE / "requests" / (case + ".json")
    if case in BRANCH_CASES:
        variant, response = case.rsplit("__", 1)
        return (variant_request(variant, response),
                HERE / "branch-requests" / (case + ".json"))
    raise ValueError("Unknown exact case")


def check(case):
    item, saved = resolve_case(case)
    if case in CASES:
        check_pair(*(request(name) for name in CASES))
    else:
        check_branch_pair(item["variant"])
    if json.loads(saved.read_text()) != item:
        raise ValueError("Saved source request differs from exact scene")
    if {c["name"]: (c["width"], c["height"]) for c in item["cameras"]} != CAMERA_DIMENSIONS:
        raise ValueError("Camera profile mismatch")
    return {"passed": True, "case_id": item["case_id"],
            "request_sha256": sha(saved.read_bytes()),
            "frames": item["frames"], "camera_count": 4,
            "carla_imported": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def _native_location(carla, authored):
    return carla.Location(x=authored[0], y=-authored[1], z=authored[2])


def _camera_pose(carla, name):
    locations = {
        "overview": (-20, -20, 35),
        "approach": (5, -8, 5),
        "reference_corner": (10, -12, 8),
        "driver_reference": (-65, -1.75, 5),
    }
    x, authored_y, z = locations[name]
    y = -authored_y
    aim_x, aim_y, aim_z = 15, 5, 1.5
    yaw = math.degrees(math.atan2(aim_y - y, aim_x - x))
    pitch = math.degrees(math.atan2(aim_z - z, math.hypot(aim_x - x, aim_y - y)))
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                           carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw, pitch=pitch))


def _write_once(path, value):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def _speed(actor):
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    return math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)


def _body_xy(actor):
    vertices = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())
    return [[vertex.x, vertex.y] for vertex in vertices]


def emergency_light_state(light_state, active):
    """Request both special lamp channels named by the exact scene."""
    if not active:
        return light_state.NONE
    return light_state.Special1 | light_state.Special2


def emergency_motion_control(speed_mps, target_mps, active):
    """Bound the requested moving subject near its exact low-speed target."""
    if not active:
        return 0.0, 1.0
    error = target_mps - speed_mps
    if error <= 0:
        return 0.0, min(.2, max(0.0, -error * .2))
    return min(.2, .05 + .2 * error), 0.0


def branch_actors(carla, world, item, emergency):
    """Build optional hand-signal or officer actors from the exact request."""
    built = {}
    for field in ("source_driver_proxy", "officer_actor"):
        spec = item.get(field)
        if spec is None:
            continue
        actor = spawn_indication_actor(carla, world, spec["blueprint"],
                                       spec["spawn_xyz_m"],
                                       emergency if field == "source_driver_proxy" else None)
        built[field] = actor
    return built


def branch_indication(carla, item, built, index):
    """Record requested pose and Native readback, never pixel visibility."""
    rows = {}
    for field, interval_key in (("source_driver_proxy", "signal_frames"),
                                ("officer_actor", "direction_frames")):
        actor = built.get(field)
        if actor is None:
            continue
        spec = item[field]
        first, last = spec[interval_key]
        if index == first:
            rows[field] = apply_indication(carla, actor, spec["arm_side"])
        elif index == last + 1:
            actor.hide_pose()
            rows[field] = {"pose_hidden": True,
                           "original_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
                           "source_identity_verified": False}
        elif first < index <= last:
            names = {bone.name if hasattr(bone, "name") else bone[0]
                     for bone in actor.get_bones().bone_transforms}
            required = {f"crl_{part}__{spec['arm_side']}"
                        for part in ("shoulder", "arm", "foreArm", "hand")}
            if not required <= names:
                raise RuntimeError("Native indication readback lost during requested interval")
            rows[field] = {"native_bones_read_back": True,
                           "original_pixel_visibility_verified": False,
                           "source_identity_verified": False}
        if field in rows:
            rows[field]["native_actor_id"] = actor.id
    return rows


def execute(case, output, host, port):
    check(case)
    root = Path(os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", "")).resolve()
    scratch = (REPO / ".runtime-work").resolve()
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if not root.is_relative_to(scratch) or not output.is_relative_to(scratch):
        raise ValueError("Set output root and capture output under .runtime-work")
    if not output.is_dir() or output != HERE:
        raise ValueError("Capture requires its fresh materialized exact bundle")
    if any((output / name).exists() for name in (
            "native-request.json", "observed-actors.jsonl", "motion_history.jsonl",
            "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("Original acquisition already exists")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "runtime"))
    import carla
    import numpy as np
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture

    item, _ = resolve_case(case)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(180)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    world = client.get_world()
    if saved["settings"].synchronous_mode or any(
            actor.type_id.startswith(("vehicle.", "walker.", "sensor."))
            for actor in world.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError("Exclusive idle asynchronous CARLA world required")
    actors, encoders, handles, cameras = [], {}, {}, {}
    changed, frames, error, restored = False, 0, None, None
    try:
        xml = item["source_map"]
        _write_once(output / "native-request.json", item)
        (output / "scene.xodr").write_text(xml + "\n")
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(xml, carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(
            vertex_distance=.25, max_road_length=50, wall_height=0,
            additional_width=0, smooth_junctions=False,
            enable_mesh_visibility=True, enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed = True
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        ego_bp = library.find(item["ego_blueprint"])
        emergency_bp = library.find(item["emergency_blueprint"])
        ego_bp.set_attribute("role_name", "c405647_ego")
        emergency_bp.set_attribute("role_name", "c405647_emergency_request")
        ego = world.spawn_actor(ego_bp, carla.Transform(
            _native_location(carla, item["ego_start_xyz_m"])))
        actors.append(ego)
        emergency = world.spawn_actor(emergency_bp, carla.Transform(
            _native_location(carla, item["emergency_start_xyz_m"])))
        actors.append(emergency)
        indication = branch_actors(carla, world, item, emergency)
        actors.extend(indication.values())
        ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(brake=1))
        emergency.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(brake=1))
        for _ in range(30):
            world.tick()
        mapping = world.get_map()
        for name, actor, lane_type in (("ego", ego, carla.LaneType.Driving),
                                       ("emergency", emergency, carla.LaneType.Shoulder)):
            waypoint = mapping.get_waypoint(actor.get_location(), project_to_road=False,
                                            lane_type=lane_type)
            if waypoint is None or waypoint.road_id != item["road_id"]:
                raise RuntimeError(name + " is not on its requested Native road lane")
        _write_once(output / "native-map-readback.json", {
            "original_opendrive_sha256": sha(mapping.to_opendrive().encode()),
            "requested_map_sha256": sha(xml.encode()),
            "initial_road_id": item["road_id"], "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        for spec in item["cameras"]:
            name = spec["name"]
            bp = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            for attr, value in (("image_size_x", spec["width"]),
                                ("image_size_y", spec["height"]),
                                ("sensor_tick", 0)):
                bp.set_attribute(attr, str(value))
            camera = world.spawn_actor(bp, _camera_pose(carla, name))
            actors.append(camera)
            cameras[name] = queue.Queue()
            camera.listen(cameras[name].put)
            handles[name] = (output / (name + ".encoder.log")).open("x")
            encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen([
                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
                "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-s",
                f"{spec['width']}x{spec['height']}", "-r", "20", "-i", "pipe:0",
                "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", str(output / (name + ".mkv"))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=handles[name])
        with (output / "observed-actors.jsonl").open("x") as observed_file, \
             (output / "motion_history.jsonl").open("x") as motion_file, \
             (output / "trace.jsonl").open("x") as trace_file, \
             (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as frame_file:
            for index in range(item["frames"]):
                indication_readback = branch_indication(carla, item, indication, index)
                target = item["ego_response_policy"]
                brake = target["brake_command"] if (target["brake_onset_frame"] is not None
                           and index >= target["brake_onset_frame"]) else 0.0
                cruise_error = item["ego_cruise_speed_mps"] - _speed(ego)
                throttle = 0 if brake else max(0, min(.45, .15 + .25 * cruise_error))
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake))
                emergency_throttle, emergency_brake = emergency_motion_control(
                    _speed(emergency), item["emergency_target_speed_mps"],
                    index >= item["emergency_motion_start_frame"])
                emergency.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(
                    throttle=emergency_throttle, brake=emergency_brake))
                requested_lamp = index % 10 < 5
                emergency.set_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState(
                    emergency_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState, requested_lamp)))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                timestamp = world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                observed = {name: {"native_center_xy_m": [actor.get_location().x,
                                                           actor.get_location().y],
                                   "native_body_xy_m": _body_xy(actor),
                                   "native_speed_mps": _speed(actor),
                                   "native_yaw_deg": actor.get_transform().rotation.yaw}
                            for name, actor in (("ego", ego), ("emergency", emergency))}
                observed_file.write(json.dumps({"frame": index,
                    "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": timestamp,
                    "source_kind": "original_native_motion", "actors": observed,
                    "ego_brake_request": brake,
                    "ego_cruise_throttle_request": throttle,
                    "ego_brake_observed": ego.get_control().brake,
                    "lamp_request": requested_lamp,
                    "lamp_state_observed": bool(emergency.get_light_state() &
                                                carla.VehicleLightState.Special1) and
                                           bool(emergency.get_light_state() &
                                                carla.VehicleLightState.Special2),
                    "indication_native_readback": indication_readback,
                    "indication_source_review": "pending_original_identity_and_pixels",
                    "light_qualification": "pending_independent_source_review"}) + "\n")
                motion_file.write(json.dumps({"frame": native_frame,
                    "time_s": index / 20,
                    "ego_body_xy_m": observed["ego"]["native_body_xy_m"],
                    "emergency_body_xy_m": observed["emergency"]["native_body_xy_m"],
                    "ego_speed_mps": observed["ego"]["native_speed_mps"],
                    "emergency_speed_mps": observed["emergency"]["native_speed_mps"],
                    "ego_brake_observed": ego.get_control().brake}) + "\n")
                trace_file.write(json.dumps({"frame": native_frame,
                    "time_s": index / 20,
                    "position_m": [ego.get_location().x, ego.get_location().y],
                    "ego_speed_mps": observed["ego"]["native_speed_mps"],
                    "emergency_speed_mps": observed["emergency"]["native_speed_mps"]}) + "\n")
                for spec in item["cameras"]:
                    name = spec["name"]
                    image = cameras[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame < native_frame:
                        image = cameras[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame != native_frame:
                        raise RuntimeError("Original camera and Native frame join failed")
                    rgb = np.frombuffer(image.raw_data, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
                        spec["height"], spec["width"], 4)[:, :, :3][:, :, ::-1]
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                frame_file.write(json.dumps({"video_frame": index,
                    "native_frame": native_frame, "carla_frame": native_frame,
                    "time_s": index / 20}) + "\n")
                frames += 1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc),
                 "traceback": traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        for name, process in encoders.items():
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=180):
                    raise RuntimeError(name + " lossless encoder failed")
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"encoder_error": str(exc)}
            handles[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith("sensor.") and actor.is_listening:
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"cleanup_error": str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:
                restored = restore(client, saved)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"restore_error": str(exc)}
        _write_once(output / "native-capture-report.json", {
            "case_id": item["case_id"], "frames": frames,
            "expected_frames": item["frames"], "error": error,
            "restoration": restored, "accepted": False,
            "original_pixel_review_required": True,
            "vehicle_and_lamp_qualification_required": True})
    if error or frames != item["frames"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Native capture incomplete; inspect scratch report")
    (output / "acquisition-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}) + "\n")
    seal_capture(output, frames=frames, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in cameras},
                 context={"case_id": item["case_id"], "road_id": item["road_id"]})

def road_xml():
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4",
                  name="C405647-emergency-approach", version="1",
                  north="20", south="-20", east="110", west="-110",

                         length="200", junction="-1")
    ET.SubElement(road, "link")
    view = ET.SubElement(road, "planView")
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(view, "geometry", s="0", x="-100",
                                y="0", hdg="0", length="200"), "line")
    profile = ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile")
    ET.SubElement(profile, "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
    ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
    ET.SubElement(section, "left")
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, "center"), "lane", id="0",
                  type="none", level="false")
    right = ET.SubElement(section, "right")
    for ident, kind, width in (("-1", "driving", "3.5"),
                               ("-2", "shoulder", "3.0")):

                             level="false")
        ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a=width, b="0", c="0", d="0")
    ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
    ET.SubElement(road, "signals")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")

def check_pair(first, second):
    if first != request(CASES[0]) or second != request(CASES[1]):
        raise ValueError("Exact emergency-approach requests changed")
    root = ET.fromstring(first["source_map"])
    lanes = {lane.get("id"): lane.get("type")
             for lane in root.findall(".//lane")}
    if lanes.get("-1") != "driving" or lanes.get("-2") != "shoulder":
        raise ValueError("Travel lane and visible shoulder required")
    if first["emergency_start_xyz_m"][1] >= first["ego_start_xyz_m"][1]:
        raise ValueError("Emergency subject must be beside travel lane")
    fixed = set(first) - {"case_id", "ego_response_policy", "requested_setting"}
    if {key: first[key] for key in fixed} != {key: second[key] for key in fixed}:
        raise ValueError("Non-response comparison context changed")
    if first["ego_response_policy"] == second["ego_response_policy"]:
        raise ValueError("Response policy was not varied")
    return {"passed": True, "exact_cases": [first["case_id"], second["case_id"]],
            "physical_or_legal_acceptance": False}


def write(directory):
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pair = [request(condition) for condition in CASES]
    check_pair(*pair)
    for condition, data in zip(CASES, pair):
        (directory / (condition + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
    return pair
